title: DON'T Buy a Used Mining GPU! - $h!t Manufacturers Say
summary: Linus Tech Tips looks at whether buying a used GPU that was previously used for crypto mining is a good idea, as miners prepare to sell off cards. The video discusses how mining affects wear on cards and what to watch for.
why: HN cites it as evidence that mining does not meaningfully degrade GPUs, so used mining cards are generally fine buys.

quote.text: Linus tech tips had an episode on it, and largely found that the performance degradation was insignificant
